stemMd: Why was the machine unavailable for two weeks?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A failed valve’s replacement took that long to arrive.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every spare part had become expensive.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The machine was no longer needed.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The workshop had decided never to repair machines.

explanationMd: The delay came from obtaining the replacement valve, not necessarily from the complexity or price of the repair. The example shows why delivery time can matter more than unit cost.

distractorRationale.e: It sought a replacement and revised planning.
distractorRationale.d: Its unavailability is treated as a costly interruption.
